source_finding.observed_behavior: record_execution commits the base execution_receipts row in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction; record_execution_v2_metadata then opens and commits a second BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. guarded_dispatch invokes those two persistence calls sequentially after the external dispatch callback returns.
source_finding.failure_window: A crash, storage error, process kill, or second-write failure after the first COMMIT can leave execution_receipts present while execution_v2_metadata is absent.
source_finding.epistemic_effect: Completion remains fail-closed because v2 completion validation requires the missing metadata, but the post-dispatch recovery/audit state becomes partial and cannot be described as one atomic execution receipt bundle.
source_finding.counterhypothesis: Late fail-closed completion rejection is sufficient and no atomic execution bundle is needed.
source_finding.counterhypothesis_assessment: REJECTED_AS_TOO_WEAK_FOR_RECOVERY_EXACTNESS: the system already treats SUBMITTED-and-later failures as outcome-unknown; splitting two identity-bearing execution records across commits creates avoidable ambiguity in that exact crash window.

next_source_gate.goal: Persist the base ExecutionReceipt plus source_digest/duplicate_state/status metadata in one SQLite writer transaction after a returned dispatch observation.
next_source_gate.required_regression: Inject failure between the two logical inserts and prove rollback leaves neither execution_receipts nor execution_v2_metadata; successful path must commit both with one invocation/request/source/generation lineage.
next_source_gate.compatibility_requirement: Do not introduce a second effect authority or a second lifecycle store; fold the fix into the existing Frankenstein2 effect lifecycle/dispatch boundary lane.
next_source_gate.execution_requirement: Repository-bound deterministic execution remains required before test or runtime credit; zero-step Actions failure is not a semantic failure.
